diagnostics.message: The explicit depends_on from :resource.local_file.public_ssh_key to :resource.tls_private_key.ssh duplicates the dependency already established by the content reference.
The explicit depends_on from :resource.local_file.private_ssh_key to :resource.tls_private_key.ssh duplicates the dependency already established by the content reference.
The module runner already receives ssh_public_key.content from :resource.local_file.public_ssh_key, so the module dependency covers this target without an explicit depends_on.

The chmod provisioner should run after :resource.local_file.private_ssh_key creates the private key file. The command uses only the filename variable, so Terraform cannot infer this ordering from an attribute reference.
